node.statement: Because every p_i is positive, multiplying n(w_i-w_k) <= n(w_i)+n(w_k) by p_i preserves the inequality. Summing these finitely many inequalities over i and distributing the finite sum over addition gives sum_i p_i n(w_i-w_k) <= sum_i p_i n(w_i)+sum_i p_i n(w_k), which is the claimed bound.
